commit_message: Complete ADR 0123 live Behavior Tree debugging
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0123 live Behavior Tree debugging
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a transient Play-mode Behavior Tree view driven only by the bounded runtime snapshot
- map runtime GraphId/NodeId state onto a read-only graph canvas with Running, terminal and lifecycle overlays
- clear stale presentation on Play stop, runtime reload, runner loss, generation changes and source graph replacement
- add deterministic Editor visual-validation presentation for this live overlay

## Data path

BehaviorTreeRunner::snapshot() -> RuntimePlayState read-only query -> source GraphId/NodeId lookup -> detached EditorSession -> transient GraphDebugOverlay. The Editor does not execute or reinterpret Behavior Tree semantics and never writes debug state into Graph or GraphView.

## Scope

No Audio, Navigation or VFX implementation files are changed. Serialized Graph/GraphView formats, Stable IDs, compiled DTOs, Cargo manifests and production public APIs are unchanged. PR #84 remains separate; its CLI schema-count fix is not duplicated here.
